title: Whirlpool assurance response & artifact register
summary: Working register of Redwood responses to Whirlpool's assurance questionnaire plus an indexed inventory of artifacts produced during the Dedicated POC. This doc is a pragmatic bridge between the questionnaire PDF and the raw evidence bundle: concise answers, artefact pointers, gaps with RAG status, and next-action owners for audit-readiness. Target audience: Whirlpool security review team and Redwood Solutions/Platform leads.
questionnaire_responses: Q1: Data residency and segmentation — Answer: Hosted control plane with customer-configurable VPC peering and support for region pinning; Dedicated deployment used for POC with single-tenant GPU pool and subnet isolation. Evidence: network-topology-diagram.pdf, vpc-peering-setup.txt

Q2: Key management and encryption at rest — Answer: All persistent model artifacts and customer data at rest encrypted with AES-256; Customer KMS integration demonstrated (AWS KMS). Evidence: kms-config-export.tar.gz, kms-integration-runbook.md
Q3: Access control and privileged access — Answer: RBAC enforced via SSO (OIDC); least-privilege service roles for runtime. Evidence: iam-policy-snapshot.csv, sso-assertion-sample.txt

Q4: Logging, retention, and audit logs — Answer: Audit logs forwarded to customer managed S3 or SIEM via syslog; default retention 90 days for hosted, configurable for Dedicated. Evidence: audit-log-sample.json, log-forwarding-config.yml
Q5: Secure software supply and build provenance — Answer: Builds reproducible from tagged CI artifacts; SBOM generated for runtime images. Evidence: sbom-whirlpool-poc.json, ci-build-logs.txt

gaps_and_risks: G1: HSM integration not validated in POC environment — risk: key compromise mitigation not fully demonstrated
G2: SIEM playbook for incident response not customized for Whirlpool's internal processes — risk: delayed incident handling
G3: Formal penetration test report pending — risk: undiscovered medium/high vulnerabilities
G4: Long-term log retention beyond 1 year requires additional storage planning and legal review
